claims.text: The paper integrates a language model (LM) with cross-lingual word embedding to improve context-aware word translation.
It proposes methods that utilize a language model for context-aware lexical choices during translation, enhancing the accuracy of word selection based on context.
The integration of a language model allows for improved handling of word-by-word translation, surpassing traditional unsupervised neural translation systems.
